description: This file defines API routes and logic for analytics-related endpoints in a FastAPI web application. It includes functionality for computing on-demand analytics (such as daily commit and PR counts), as well as retrieving dashboard metrics, activity feeds, and contributing statistics. The code interacts with SQL databases via raw SQL queries to update and fetch analytics data, and exposes these operations via REST API endpoints.

classes.name: AnalyticsComputeRequest
classes.description: Request model for computing analytics, including org_id, optional repo_id, start_date, and end_date.

classes.name: AnalyticsComputeResponse
classes.description: Response model summarizing the result of analytics computation, including counts of upserted rows and timestamps.

classes.name: DayCountPoint
classes.description: Model representing daily counts for commits or similar metrics.

classes.name: PullRequestsDayPoint
classes.description: Model representing daily opened and merged PR counts.

classes.name: DashboardMetricsResponse
classes.description: Model packaging various metrics for dashboard display, including commits, PRs, active contributors, recent activity, and top repos.

classes.name: RepoCountPoint
classes.description: Model for representing repository-specific count metrics, such as merged PRs.

classes.name: RecentActivityItem
classes.description: Model for representing a recent git event with associated metadata for activity feeds.

classes.name: ActiveContributorsResponse
classes.description: Model for returning the count of active contributors within a date range.

methods.name: UUID _parse_org_id(value: str, db: Session)
methods.description: Parse an organization identifier string into a UUID, handling specific legacy values like '1' and 'default'.

methods.name: tuple[datetime,datetime] _utc_dt_range_from_dates( start_date: Optional[date], end_date: Optional[date], )
methods.description: Convert optional start/end date parameters into a UTC datetime range for querying.

methods.name: None _validate_org_repo_scope(org_id: UUID, repo_id: Optional[UUID], db: Session)
methods.description: Ensure that the repository ID (if provided) belongs to the specified organization.

methods.name: int _compute_repo_daily(db: Session, *, org_id: UUID, repo_id: Optional[UUID], start_ts: datetime, end_ts: datetime)
methods.description: Calculate and upsert daily repository-level analytics based on git events in the specified time range.

methods.name: int _compute_dev_daily(db: Session, *, org_id: UUID, repo_id: Optional[UUID], start_ts: datetime, end_ts: datetime)
methods.description: Calculate and upsert daily developer-level analytics based on git events with actor attribution.

methods.name: AnalyticsComputeResponse compute_analytics(req: AnalyticsComputeRequest, db: Session = Depends(get_db_session))
methods.description: API endpoint to trigger on-demand computation of analytics for a given org, repo, and date range.

methods.name: List[DayCountPoint] commits_per_day( org_id: str = Query(..., description="Organization UUID (or legacy '1'/'default' for default org)."), repo_id: Optional[UUID] = Query(default=None, description="Optional repo UUID."), start_date: Optional[date] = Query(default=None, description="Start date (inclusive, UTC)."), end_date: Optional[date] = Query(default=None, description="End date (exclusive, UTC)."), db: Session = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Retrieve daily commit counts for a specified organization and optional repository over a date range.

methods.name: List[PullRequestsDayPoint] prs_per_day( org_id: str = Query(..., description="Organization UUID (or legacy '1'/'default' for default org)."), repo_id: Optional[UUID] = Query(default=None, description="Optional repo UUID."), start_date: Optional[date] = Query(default=None, description="Start date (inclusive, UTC)."), end_date: Optional[date] = Query(default=None, description="End date (exclusive, UTC)."), db: Session = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Retrieve daily PR opened and merged counts for an org/repo over a date range.

methods.name: DashboardMetricsResponse dashboard_metrics( org_id: str = Query(..., description="Organization UUID (or legacy '1'/'default' for default org)."), repo_id: Optional[UUID] = Query(default=None, description="Optional repo UUID."), start_date: Optional[date] = Query(default=None, description="Start date (inclusive, UTC)."), end_date: Optional[date] = Query(default=None, description="End date (exclusive, UTC)."), recent_limit: int = Query(default=50, ge=1, le=200, description="Max recent activity items."), top_repos_limit: int = Query(default=10, ge=1, le=200, description="Max repos in merged-PR ranking."), db: Session = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Retrieve comprehensive dashboard metrics, combining commits, PRs, activity, and top repos, optionally scoped to a repo.

methods.name: List[RepoCountPoint] prs_merged_per_repo( org_id: str = Query(..., description="Organization UUID (or legacy '1'/'default' for default org)."), start_date: Optional[date] = Query(default=None, description="Start date (inclusive, UTC)."), end_date: Optional[date] = Query(default=None, description="End date (exclusive, UTC)."), limit: int = Query(default=50, ge=1, le=200, description="Max repos returned (sorted by merged count desc)."), db: Session = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Get top repositories ranked by number of merged PRs within a date range.

methods.name: ActiveContributorsResponse active_contributors( org_id: str = Query(..., description="Organization UUID (or legacy '1'/'default' for default org)."), repo_id: Optional[UUID] = Query(default=None, description="Optional repo UUID."), start_date: Optional[date] = Query(default=None, description="Start date (inclusive, UTC)."), end_date: Optional[date] = Query(default=None, description="End date (exclusive, UTC)."), db: Session = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Get count of active contributors in a specified org/repo and date range, with fallback to git events if analytics data is absent.

methods.name: List[RecentActivityItem] recent_activity( org_id: str = Query(..., description="Organization UUID (or legacy '1'/'default' for default org)."), repo_id: Optional[UUID] = Query(default=None, description="Optional repo UUID."), limit: int = Query(default=50, ge=1, le=200, description="Max events returned."), db: Session = Depends(get_db_session), )
methods.description: Get the most recent git events across repositories for an organization, to populate activity feeds.
